domain_title: Data, privacy, confidentiality and intellectual property
title: Confidentiality and information-boundary control
canonical_definition: Confidential, restricted, customer-controlled and security-sensitive information remains within approved identity, tenant, provider, logging and contractual boundaries.

conditions: When the system can access non-public, customer, employee, regulated or security-sensitive information.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are information classes, confidentiality obligations and prohibited disclosure paths explicitly defined?
Are secrets isolation, least privilege, tenant separation, provider settings and leakage controls technically enforced?
Do leakage, cross-tenant, unauthorized reuse and output-disclosure tests demonstrate effective boundaries?

capability_indicators: Secrets are excluded from model-visible context
Provider retention and training settings are known

conditions: Refer a material failure of confidentiality and information-boundary control to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MEASURE 2.7 (PDF p. 35), MEASURE 2.10 (PDF p. 35), MAP 4.2 (PDF p. 32)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on evaluating security and privacy risks and documenting controls on third-party components. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make confidentiality and information-boundary control verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: B4 evaluates confidentiality and information-boundary control using evidence from intent through operation. AP-B4 independently assesses evidence of confidentiality leakage through ai channels.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies a classification and boundary map for sensitive inputs, permitted recipients, environments, tenants and forbidden transfers. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates enforced identity and tenant checks, secret isolation, approved destinations, retention restrictions and output filtering at trust boundaries. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides authorized defensive checks covering cross-tenant denial, restricted transfers, sensitive output and versions of the isolation controls. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in confidentiality and information-boundary control, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide a classification and boundary map for sensitive inputs, permitted recipients, environments, tenants and forbidden transfers. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate enforced identity and tenant checks, secret isolation, approved destinations, retention restrictions and output filtering at trust boundaries. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide authorized defensive checks covering cross-tenant denial, restricted transfers, sensitive output and versions of the isolation controls. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how confidentiality and information-boundary control works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with a classification and boundary map for sensitive inputs, permitted recipients, environments, tenants and forbidden transfers. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use authorized defensive checks covering cross-tenant denial, restricted transfers, sensitive output and versions of the isolation controls to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: Permitted disclosure requires an evidenced recipient and authorized purpose within the classified boundary.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-B4 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in confidentiality and information-boundary control
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in confidentiality and information-boundary control
Evidence remains insufficient for confidentiality and information-boundary control in the assessed scope
